# Agent Company Plugins — Full Catalog

> Complete source inventory for external LLMs and agents. Generated deterministically from repository metadata.

## Scope

- Canonical repository: [alvarovillalbaa/plugins](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins)
- Default branch: `main`
- Inventory: 7 plugins, 147 skills, 49 commands, 26 agents, and 7 rule sets
- This document describes version-controlled source assets. It does not advertise a hosted API, agent endpoint, authentication service, or live MCP server.

## Component Selection Rules

- Prefer the narrowest component whose description matches the requested outcome.
- A skill is an atomic or routing capability; a command is a stable workflow entry point; an agent orchestrates multi-step work; a rule set supplies department-wide defaults.
- Use qualified names when the owning department matters.
- Verify current installation guidance before copying source assets into a runtime or project.
- Treat reconciliation bundles as suggestion-only local review data, never as source authority or proof that an update conflict was resolved; post-review `--accept-local` is explicit metadata adoption, not patch application.

## Plugin Catalog

### `engineering`

Own architecture, multi-agent execution, AI evaluation, delivery, quality, documentation, cloud operations, security testing, and technical risk.

- Version: `3.1.0`
- Platforms declared by profile: `claude`, `codex`, `cursor`
- [Plugin source](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/tree/main/engineering)
- [Profile](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/profile.yaml)
- Team roles: CTO, Cloud Architect, Software Engineer, Product Manager, Designer, AI Engineer

#### Skills (46)

- [`agentic-development`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/skills/agentic-development/SKILL.md) (`engineering/agentic-development`) — Router for agentic software development, system design, execution loops, release landing, harness improvement, and technical debt work.
- [`architecture`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/skills/architecture/SKILL.md) (`engineering/architecture`) — Use for system architecture, technical design, interface decisions, planning, and architecture tradeoff work. Child of `agentic-development`.
- [`multi-agent`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/skills/multi-agent/SKILL.md) (`engineering/multi-agent`) — Route and coordinate multi-agent work across expert councils, adaptive loops, dependency graphs, and persistent goals. Use when several agents or workstreams must collaborate.
- [`council`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/skills/council/SKILL.md) (`engineering/council`) — Convene a bounded panel of expert personas to independently analyze a decision, critique each other, and produce one ruling with evidence and dissent. For high-uncertainty decisions.
- [`agentic-loops`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/skills/agentic-loops/SKILL.md) (`engineering/agentic-loops`) — Run a bounded inspect-act-verify-adapt loop that picks the next action until acceptance criteria are met or the budget runs out. For implementation, debugging, and investigation.
- [`agentic-graphs`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/skills/agentic-graphs/SKILL.md) (`engineering/agentic-graphs`) — Decompose complex work into a dynamic dependency graph, schedule ready nodes, coordinate parallel agents, and validate handoffs. For multi-workstream tasks a linear plan can't represent.
- [`agentic-goals`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/skills/agentic-goals/SKILL.md) (`engineering/agentic-goals`) — Define, persist, resume, and pursue an explicit user-authorized goal across turns with success criteria and evidence. Use when the agent must keep pursuing an outcome over time.
- [`release-landing`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/skills/release-landing/SKILL.md) (`engineering/release-landing`) — Use for engineering release landing, merge hygiene, deployment gates, hotfixes, tags, and rollback posture. Child of `agentic-development`.
- [`agent-harness`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/skills/agent-harness/SKILL.md) (`engineering/agent-harness`) — Use for repo agent-readiness, harness loops, instruction files, hooks, scratch space, CI feedback loops, and execution reliability. Child of `agentic-development`.
- [`tech-debt`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/skills/tech-debt/SKILL.md) (`engineering/tech-debt`) — Use for technical-debt elimination, refactor plans, dependency cleanup, anti-pattern removal, and schedulable debt cadences. Child of `agentic-development`.
- [`ai-engineering`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/skills/ai-engineering/SKILL.md) (`engineering/ai-engineering`) — Router for AI system architecture, prompt/tool design, context and memory RAG, production AI eval observability, governance/safety, data/ML pipelines, and computer vision systems.

- [`ai-evals-observability`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/skills/ai-evals-observability/SKILL.md) (`engineering/ai-evals-observability`) — Design and operate production evidence collection for AI systems — traces, telemetry, cost, drift signals, dashboards, and alerts. Feeds evidence to `ai-evals`, not the gate itself.

Child of `ai-engineering`.

Child of `ai-engineering`.

Child skill of `cloud`; route here from the parent router when this lane is the narrowest owner.

Child of `cloud`.

Child of `pentest`.

- [`quality-assurance`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/skills/quality-assurance/SKILL.md) (`engineering/quality-assurance`) — Route testing, behavior-preserving simplification, security validation, and authoritative AI evaluation work to the narrowest Engineering child, and own the canonical test-suite contract - the tests folder layout, the five test-data tiers including read-only production access, and the framework-per-test-type mapping.
- [`testing`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/skills/testing/SKILL.md) (`engineering/testing`) — Route and execute test strategy, coverage, backend, frontend E2E, flake, and explicitly authorized business-logic or race-condition testing.
- [`frontend-e2e`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/skills/frontend-e2e/SKILL.md) (`engineering/frontend-e2e`) — Use for browser QA, Playwright/Cypress flows, user-visible state validation, trace capture, and frontend regressions. Child of `testing`.
- [`flake`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/skills/flake/SKILL.md) (`engineering/flake`) — Use for CI failures, flaky tests, ordering problems, environment drift, cache issues, and quality gate recovery. Child of `testing`.
- [`simplify`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/skills/simplify/SKILL.md) (`engineering/simplify`) — Reduce duplication, indirection, branching, and unnecessary code in a defined scope while preserving behavior and proving the result.
- [`security`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/skills/security/SKILL.md) (`engineering/security`) — Use for passive security review, threat modeling, secure-code checks, dependency review, and compliance-oriented findings. Child of `quality-assurance`.
- [`ai-evals`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/skills/ai-evals/SKILL.md) (`engineering/ai-evals`) — Design, implement, calibrate, run, compare, and gate provider-neutral evaluations for LLMs, agents, RAG, tools, and prompts, with statistical comparison and release gates.
- [`code-documentation`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/skills/code-documentation/SKILL.md) (`engineering/code-documentation`) — Write, update, review, or continuously improve documentation for code, repos, services, and workflows — READMEs, runbooks, changelogs, ADRs, and docstrings.

#### Commands (17)

- [`repo-review`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/commands/repo-review.md) (`engineering/repo-review`) — Review a repository or subsystem's current state and return prioritized quality, maintainability, and operational findings.
- [`grill-with-docs`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/commands/grill-with-docs.md) (`engineering/grill-with-docs`) — Stress-test a technical plan or design while keeping documentation, ADR, glossary, or decision-log context aligned.
- [`review-architecture`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/commands/review-architecture.md) (`engineering/review-architecture`) — Review architecture, ownership boundaries, and maintainability risks for a repo area, plan, branch, or proposed design.
- [`deslop`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/commands/deslop.md) (`engineering/deslop`) — Remove AI-code residue and local maintainability noise without changing product behavior.
- [`pr-merge`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/commands/pr-merge.md) (`engineering/pr-merge`) — Prepare and perform a local PR landing merge with explicit gates. Does not push by default.
- [`retro`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/commands/retro.md) (`engineering/retro`) — Analyze recent engineering work, PRs, quality signals, and lessons to produce follow-up actions.
- [`docs-pass`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/commands/docs-pass.md) (`engineering/docs-pass`) — Update or create the right technical documentation for a code change, service, or workflow using the code-documentation skill.
- [`browser-trace`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/commands/browser-trace.md) (`engineering/browser-trace`) — Capture browser observability for one URL and return searchable network, DOM, screenshot, and console evidence.
- [`cancel-dev-loop`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/commands/cancel-dev-loop.md) (`engineering/cancel-dev-loop`) — Cancel an active agentic development loop by removing its state file.
- [`check-agent-compat`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/commands/check-agent-compat.md) (`engineering/check-agent-compat`) — Run a full repo compatibility pass — scanner score, docs reliability, startup path, and validation efficiency — and produce a P0/P1/P2 finding list before extending agent autonomy.
- [`dev-loop`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/commands/dev-loop.md) (`engineering/dev-loop`) — Start an agentic development loop in the current session — re-injects your task prompt each iteration until the completion promise is output or max iterations is reached.
- [`docs-site`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/commands/docs-site.md) (`engineering/docs-site`) — Research a software project and build a complete documentation website using the project's existing stack or a justified portable default.
- [`fix-ci`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/commands/fix-ci.md) (`engineering/fix-ci`) — Diagnose failing continuous-integration checks, apply targeted local fixes, and verify the affected checks without assuming a hosting provider.
- [`harness-loop`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/commands/harness-loop.md) (`engineering/harness-loop`) — Run a harness engineering improvement loop — audits the repo each iteration, picks the highest-priority finding, enforces it as a CI gate or structural test, and stops when no P0 or P1 findings remain.
- [`orchestrate`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/commands/orchestrate.md) (`engineering/orchestrate`) — Decompose a large goal into bounded agent workstreams, coordinate dependencies, and verify the integrated result with one controller.
- [`review-pr`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/commands/review-pr.md) (`engineering/review-pr`) — Run a comprehensive multi-lens PR review. Covers code quality, silent failures, test coverage, and comment accuracy. Defaults to the current git diff; accepts a branch, PR number, or file list.
- [`triage-prs`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/commands/triage-prs.md) (`engineering/triage-prs`) — Intent-first PR triage. Processes a list of PRs, issues, or a whole queue. Recovers plain-language intent, judges whether the implementation solves the real problem, and routes each item to close, escalate, or continue. Follows the triage protocol from prs.

#### Agents (7)

- [`principal-engineer`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/agents/principal-engineer.md) (`engineering/principal-engineer`) — Leads architecture, implementation strategy, code quality, and technical delivery across the engineering surface.
- [`cto`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/agents/cto.md) (`engineering/cto`) — Owns technical strategy, architecture direction, staffing shape, delivery risk, and engineering investment tradeoffs.
- [`cloud-architect`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/agents/cloud-architect.md) (`engineering/cloud-architect`) — Designs and reviews cloud architecture, deployment, cost, security, and reliability plans.
- [`software-engineer`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/agents/software-engineer.md) (`engineering/software-engineer`) — Implements scoped product or platform changes using existing repo patterns and focused verification.
- [`ai-engineer`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/agents/ai-engineer.md) (`engineering/ai-engineer`) — Builds and reviews AI systems, evals, prompt/tool design, RAG, context, and safety-aware model workflows.
- [`pr-reviewer`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/agents/pr-reviewer.md) (`engineering/pr-reviewer`) — Runs a comprehensive multi-lens PR review. Use when the user wants a thorough pre-merge review covering code quality, silent failures, test coverage, and comment accuracy. By default reviews the current git diff; can be scoped to specific files, a PR number, or a branch. Returns findings grouped by severity with file:line references and concrete fix suggestions. Should be invoked proactively before creating a PR or after completing a significant feature.
- [`pr-triage`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/agents/pr-triage.md) (`engineering/pr-triage`) — Intent-first PR triage agent. Processes a list of PRs, issues, or issue descriptions by recovering the plain-language intent behind each, judging whether the implementation actually solves the underlying problem, and routing each item to: close, escalate to a human (needs judgment / ready for landing), or continue autonomously through validation, review, and CI. Use when managing a PR queue, doing a queue health pass, or deciding which PRs should keep moving. Handles each item independently.

#### Rule sets (1)

- [`defaults`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/engineering/rules/defaults.md) (`engineering/defaults`) — Runtime-neutral policy for the engineering plugin. These rules apply to every engineering skill and agent. Platform safety requirements and the user's explicitly authorized scope take precedence; narrower skills may add compatible implementation detail but may not relax the authorization gates or contradict the ownership boundaries below.

### `finances`

Run finance operations, reconciliation, planning, taxes, fundraising, fiscal close, and analysis.

- Version: `3.0.0`
- Platforms declared by profile: `claude`, `codex`, `cursor`
- [Plugin source](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/tree/main/finances)
- [Profile](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/finances/profile.yaml)
- Team roles: CEO, CFO, Financial Analyst, Accountant

#### Skills (10)

- [`finances`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/finances/skills/finances/SKILL.md) (`finances/finances`) — Router for finance operations, planning, taxes, fundraising, fiscal close, and analysis.
- [`expenses`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/finances/skills/expenses/SKILL.md) (`finances/expenses`) — Use for expense operations, bill monitoring, receipt intake, categorization, recurring bill calendars, and spend alerts. Child of `finances`.
- [`reconciliation`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/finances/skills/reconciliation/SKILL.md) (`finances/reconciliation`) — Use for bank reconciliation, GL/subledger tie-outs, receipt matching, variance explanation, and evidence tracking. Child of `finances`.
- [`planning`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/finances/skills/planning/SKILL.md) (`finances/planning`) — Use for financial planning, CFO briefings, burn/runway, scenario models, budgets, forecasts, and board-ready finance narratives. Child of `finances`.
- [`taxes`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/finances/skills/taxes/SKILL.md) (`finances/taxes`) — Use for tax document readiness, evidence packaging, tax-year checklists, entity scoping, and filing-prep organization. Child of `finances`.
- [`fundraising`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/finances/skills/fundraising/SKILL.md) (`finances/fundraising`) — Use for fundraising finance support, diligence materials, investor data rooms, process diagnostics, and finance-backed investor answers. Child of `finances`.
- [`fiscal-close`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/finances/skills/fiscal-close/SKILL.md) (`finances/fiscal-close`) — Use for month-end close calendars, owners, blockers, dependencies, close dashboards, T+ cadences, and accelerated close work. Child of `finances`.
- [`quantitative`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/finances/skills/quantitative/SKILL.md) (`finances/quantitative`) — Use for quantitative finance analysis, modeling, portfolio metrics, statistical analysis, and structured numerical decision support. Child of `finances`.
- [`fundamentals`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/finances/skills/fundamentals/SKILL.md) (`finances/fundamentals`) — Use for fundamental company analysis, financial statement review, unit economics, valuation inputs, and business quality assessment. Child of `finances`.
- [`macro`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/finances/skills/macro/SKILL.md) (`finances/macro`) — Use for macro analysis, market regime review, rates/inflation/currency context, sector-level implications, and scenario framing. Child of `finances`.

#### Commands (5)

- [`reconcile-books`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/finances/commands/reconcile-books.md) (`finances/reconcile-books`) — Reconcile bank statements, receipts, and ledger rows into auditable outputs using the finances skill.
- [`model-scenarios`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/finances/commands/model-scenarios.md) (`finances/model-scenarios`) — Build, review, or extend a financial model and produce scenario outputs using the finances skill.
- [`investor-messaging`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/finances/commands/investor-messaging.md) (`finances/investor-messaging`) — Generate the investor narrative, tailored hooks, and FAQ rebuttals from fundraising materials using the fundraising skill.

- [`initial`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/sales/skills/initial/SKILL.md) (`sales/initial`) — Draft first-touch outreach for email, LinkedIn, X, and direct response channels.
- [`sequence`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/sales/skills/sequence/SKILL.md) (`sales/sequence`) — Design multi-touch outbound sequences with channel, timing, and message progression.
- [`follow-up`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/sales/skills/follow-up/SKILL.md) (`sales/follow-up`) — Use for follow-up messages, waiting-state nudges, reply drafting, conversation continuation, and next-step recovery. Child of `outreach`.
- [`linkedin-dms`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/sales/skills/linkedin-dms/SKILL.md) (`sales/linkedin-dms`) — Use for LinkedIn comments, connection requests, DM replies, follow-up sequences, and professional engagement writing. Child of `outreach`.
- [`x-dms`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/sales/skills/x-dms/SKILL.md) (`sales/x-dms`) — Draft and refine X direct messages and reply-to-DM sales motions.
- [`launches`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/sales/skills/launches/SKILL.md) (`sales/launches`) — Router for launch motions and virality systems.
- [`virality`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/sales/skills/virality/SKILL.md) (`sales/virality`) — Use for viral X launch systems, launch threads, controversy research, sequence planning, and performance-oriented post variants. Child of `launches`.
- [`growth`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/sales/skills/growth/SKILL.md) (`sales/growth`) — Route revenue operations while directly owning customer growth, retention, expansion, churn-risk review, lifecycle nudges, and growth experiments.
- [`revenue-ops`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/sales/skills/revenue-ops/SKILL.md) (`sales/revenue-ops`) — Use for revenue operations, CRM stages, lifecycle definitions, handoff rules, pipeline hygiene, and operating metrics. Child of `growth`.

#### Commands (5)

- [`account-brief`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/sales/commands/account-brief.md) (`sales/account-brief`) — Produce a focused account or prospect research brief using prospect, without drafting full outreach sequences.
- [`meet-with-clients`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/sales/commands/meet-with-clients.md) (`sales/meet-with-clients`) — Prepare, run, and follow up on client meetings with sales, technical-sales, and follow-up workflows.
- [`competitor-scan`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/sales/commands/competitor-scan.md) (`sales/competitor-scan`) — Run a focused competitor or market-moves scan using productivity research skills.
- [`launch-virality`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/sales/commands/launch-virality.md) (`sales/launch-virality`) — Build an evidence-led X launch campaign with positioning, post variants, distribution phases, and measurable follow-through.
- [`growth-experiment`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/sales/commands/growth-experiment.md) (`sales/growth-experiment`) — Plan a focused growth experiment using the sales growth skill.

#### Agents (4)

- [`cso`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/sales/agents/cso.md) (`sales/cso`) — Owns GTM strategy, pipeline health, revenue operating model, sales priorities, and commercial tradeoffs.
- [`gtm-engineer`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/sales/agents/gtm-engineer.md) (`sales/gtm-engineer`) — Builds and improves GTM systems, campaign automation, data flows, and revenue experiments.
- [`sdr`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/sales/agents/sdr.md) (`sales/sdr`) — Runs prospecting, lead-signal capture, account qualification, first-touch outreach, follow-up queues, and early pipeline creation.
- [`account-executive`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/sales/agents/account-executive.md) (`sales/account-executive`) — Runs discovery, demos, objections, follow-up, opportunity strategy, and deal progression.

#### Rule sets (1)

- [`defaults`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/sales/rules/defaults.md) (`sales/defaults`) — Runtime-neutral policy for the Sales plugin. These rules apply to every sales skill and agent. Platform safety requirements and the user's explicitly authorized scope take precedence; narrower skills may add compatible channel or stage detail but may not relax the authorization gates or contradict the ownership boundaries below.

### `system`

Maintain plugins, skills, memory, knowledge, learning, brain ingestion, personalization, auditable work explanations, and repeatable improvement loops.

- Version: `3.1.0`
- Platforms declared by profile: `claude`, `codex`, `cursor`
- [Plugin source](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/tree/main/system)
- [Profile](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/profile.yaml)
- Team roles: CEO, Executive Assistant, Principal Engineer

#### Skills (17)

- [`auto-improve`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/skills/auto-improve/SKILL.md) (`system/auto-improve`) — Improve project-local agent context, docs, personalization, and installed plugin/skill copies under `.agents`. Never writes upstream to the canonical plugins source.
- [`plugins-management`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/skills/plugins-management/SKILL.md) (`system/plugins-management`) — Manage plugin and skill taxonomy, project installation, no-loss updates, conflict review, lifecycle, metadata, external sources, and capability-preserving consolidation.
- [`skill-eval-loop`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/skills/skill-eval-loop/SKILL.md) (`system/skill-eval-loop`) — Use for skill evaluation loops, regression checks for skill behavior, prompt/skill mutation proposals, and explicit improvement gates. Child of `plugins-management`.
- [`memory`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/skills/memory/SKILL.md) (`system/memory`) — Retrieve, reconcile, and curate durable agent memory across available runtimes. Use when prior decisions or cross-session facts may matter, or to save/update/delete a memory.
- [`explain-yourself`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/skills/explain-yourself/SKILL.md) (`system/explain-yourself`) — Explain an agent's plan, status, decisions, or postmortem with concise, evidence-backed reasoning summaries. Use when asked what was done, why, or what remains uncertain.
- [`knowledge-base`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/skills/knowledge-base/SKILL.md) (`system/knowledge-base`) — Use for knowledge-base improvement, dedupe proposals, canonical page health, missing source promotion, and knowledge drift repair. Child of `plugins-management`.
- [`learning`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/skills/learning/SKILL.md) (`system/learning`) — Router for lessons, teaching, and durable learning records.
- [`lessons`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/skills/lessons/SKILL.md) (`system/lessons`) — Create, curate, and promote lessons from repo work, user corrections, and successful workflows.
- [`brain`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/skills/brain/SKILL.md) (`system/brain`) — Route and maintain BRAIN.md-bounded second-brain workflows — raw ingestion, folder adaptation, memory-to-knowledge compilation, and canonical knowledge updates.
- [`ingestion`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/skills/ingestion/SKILL.md) (`system/ingestion`) — Raw source ingestion, transcript/artifact parsing, canonical page promotion, and Memory-to-knowledge compilation. Child of `brain`; use when this is the narrowest owner.
- [`personalize`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/skills/personalize/SKILL.md) (`system/personalize`) — Router for user, company, voice, positioning, and ICP personalization.
- [`communication-style`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/skills/communication-style/SKILL.md) (`system/communication-style`) — Use for writing-style capture, approved-example analysis, sender or brand voice summaries, and reusable style constraints. Child of `personalize`.
- [`voice`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/skills/voice/SKILL.md) (`system/voice`) — Use for sender voice learning, approved-message analysis, style guides, forbidden phrases, and personalized writing constraints. Child of `personalize`.
- [`calibration`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/skills/calibration/SKILL.md) (`system/calibration`) — Calibrate communication and output preferences from examples, feedback, and prior accepted work.
- [`positioning`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/skills/positioning/SKILL.md) (`system/positioning`) — Use for positioning, messaging, ICP/persona framing, differentiation, objection handling, and proof-point structure. Child of `personalize`.
- [`icp`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/skills/icp/SKILL.md) (`system/icp`) — Capture, refine, and apply ideal-customer-profile signals for research, positioning, sales, and marketing work.
- [`loops`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/skills/loops/SKILL.md) (`system/loops`) — Run and maintain repeatable improvement, evaluation, memory, and experimentation loops.

#### Commands (12)

- [`learning-sync`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/commands/learning-sync.md) (`system/learning-sync`) — Capture durable project or workflow lessons and update the active repository's learning artifacts.
- [`ar-run`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/commands/ar-run.md) (`system/ar-run`; public name `ar:run`) — Run a single iteration of an autoresearch experiment. Reads state, decides one change, commits, evaluates, and keeps or discards.
- [`ar-status`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/commands/ar-status.md) (`system/ar-status`; public name `ar:status`) — Show experiment dashboard — progress, best metric, keep rate, and results table for one or all experiments.
- [`ar-loop`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/commands/ar-loop.md) (`system/ar-loop`; public name `ar:loop`) — Start an autonomous experiment loop. The experiment-runner agent runs iterations continuously, keeping improvements and discarding failures, until interrupted or the goal is met.
- [`ar-setup`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/commands/ar-setup.md) (`system/ar-setup`; public name `ar:setup`) — Create and validate the configuration for one metric-driven autoresearch experiment.
- [`compile-raw`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/commands/compile-raw.md) (`system/compile-raw`) — Compile a scoped queue of previously captured raw sources into canonical knowledge with provenance and contradiction tracking.
- [`ingest`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/commands/ingest.md) (`system/ingest`) — Capture one source into a brain's raw layer and optionally compile only that source into canonical knowledge.
- [`si-extract`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/commands/si-extract.md) (`system/si-extract`; public name `si:extract`) — Turn a proven recurring pattern or debugging solution into a standalone portable skill. The skill will work in any project with no hardcoded paths or project-specific values.
- [`si-promote`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/commands/si-promote.md) (`system/si-promote`; public name `si:promote`) — Stage, review, and explicitly approve promotion of one proven memory into its canonical policy owner without losing provenance.
- [`si-remember`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/commands/si-remember.md) (`system/si-remember`; public name `si:remember`) — Stage and explicitly confirm one provenance-rich durable memory record in an authorized store.
- [`si-review`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/commands/si-review.md) (`system/si-review`; public name `si:review`) — Perform a detailed read-only review of one scoped memory store and return evidence-backed correction, consolidation, and promotion candidates.
- [`si-status`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/commands/si-status.md) (`system/si-status`; public name `si:status`) — Show a compact read-only health snapshot for one scoped memory store, including provenance, freshness, conflicts, and capacity.

#### Agents (4)

- [`system-steward`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/agents/system-steward.md) (`system/system-steward`) — Coordinates portable plugin maintenance, knowledge flows, personalization policy, evaluation, and improvement across the system surface.
- [`experiment-runner`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/agents/experiment-runner.md) (`system/experiment-runner`) — Autonomous experimenter that optimizes a target file by a measurable metric. Reads experiment state from `.autoresearch/`, decides what ONE change to try based on accumulated evidence and strategy escalation, makes the change, commits, runs the evaluator, and keeps or discards based on outcome. Spawned by `/ar:loop` and `/ar:run`.
- [`memory-analyst`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/agents/memory-analyst.md) (`system/memory-analyst`) — Read-only analyst for one explicitly authorized memory store and its scoped policy sources. Finds freshness issues, conflicts, consolidation opportunities, and promotion candidates with provenance. Spawned by /si:review.
- [`skill-extractor`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/agents/skill-extractor.md) (`system/skill-extractor`) — Transforms a proven pattern or debugging solution into a standalone, portable Agent Skill. Generates `SKILL.md` with proper frontmatter, reference docs, and examples that work in any project. Spawned by `/si:extract` when a recurring solution should become reusable.

#### Rule sets (1)

- [`defaults`](https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/plugins/blob/main/system/rules/defaults.md) (`system/defaults`) — Runtime-neutral policy for the System plugin. These rules apply to every system skill and agent. Platform safety requirements and the user's explicitly authorized scope take precedence; narrower skills may add compatible implementation detail but may not relax the authorization gates or contradict the ownership boundaries below.
